| What you want | Where it belongs |
|---|---|
| A working link employees can open | Keep the published Manus URL, such as `https://…manus.space` |
| The project files and instructions | Push or export the project code to its private GitHub repository |
| A portfolio card with a preview button | Display the published Manus URL on the dashboard and link the card to that URL |

For each existing Manus project, open it, use **Publish** if it is not already published, copy its live `manus.space` address, and add that address to the project’s GitHub README as **Live site**. The simplest company workflow is to leave hosting in Manus and use GitHub as the company-owned code/documentation archive.

Send me the existing live Manus URLs when you have them—one per project title—and I will turn each dashboard item into the visual homepage-preview button you described.
